meta.name: Time Out
meta.description: Rahul and Radha seem to have it all - a happy marriage, a decent job and a beautiful house! But what happens when Radha's pregnancy's announcement makes Rahul realise that he's been living the life he's supposed to and not necessarily the one he wants to? Can a partner hit pause on a seemingly perfect life and revaluate his choices? And what about Radha? Is she just a collateral damage to Rahul's early mid life crisis? Watch our newest Voot Original, Time Out.

videos.title: Can you hit pause on life?
videos.overview: The perfect life, the perfect job and the perfect wife lead a 30-year-old to a life-altering meltdown. Rahul Trivedi has just realised the life he wants is a far cry from the one he's living.

videos.title: Baby or Bae?
videos.overview: Not wanting a baby is going to make Rahul's life harder he could ever imagine. As for Radha? She's just realised that the real baby is none other than Rahul, who is suddenly clueless about everything.

videos.title: On a Sabbatical, From Marriage!
videos.overview: Is taking a sabbatical from your marriage a legit excuse to mingle without being single? Adding fuel to the already raging fire? Rahul's hot neighbour Kaya.

videos.title: It's Official! We're on a Break.
videos.overview: Is a no-strings-attached hookup the best way to get over your ex? Radha discovers a little something on Rahul's neck, and then Rahul discovers Radha at his doorstep - with her hunky new boss.

videos.title: Collision Course and Collateral Damage
videos.overview: Just when things were starting to look up for Rahul, Radha files for legal separation and decides to move to New York. In a bid to find himself, has Rahul lost his love forever?

videos.title: Will He, Won't He?
videos.overview: After hitting pause on his life, job and marriage - will the new and improved Rahul 2.0 press play on happiness?
